title: Historical Evidence and Reliability of the New Testament
summary: The New Testament is supported by early manuscripts, non-biblical historical sources, and early creeds that affirm the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus.
historical_context: Multiple first and second-century sources confirm the existence and crucifixion of Jesus under Roman authority.
major_points: Early creed in 1 Corinthians 15 dates within years of crucifixion
Roman historian Tacitus references Jesus’ execution
Pliny the Younger confirms early Christian worship
Thousands of Greek manuscripts support textual reliability
Dead Sea Scrolls confirm Old Testament accuracy
The empty tomb and eyewitness testimony
